item.title: 曝特努斯要求加快 AI 研发，推动 Siri 主动处理任务
item.guid: 曝特努斯要求加快-AI-研发，推动-Siri-主动处理任务
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, Apple's new CEO John Ternus is pushing software head Craig Federighi to take a more aggressive approach to AI, hoping to further transform Siri into an AI agent capable of autonomously completing tasks. 据彭博社报道，苹果新任 CEO John Ternus 正推动软件负责人 Craig Federighi 在 AI 上采取更激进的路线，希望将 Siri 进一步改造为能自主完成任务的 AI 智能体。

Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman said that Ternus held closed-door meetings with Federighi in recent weeks, expressing dissatisfaction with the pace of Apple's AI progress and demanding an accelerated roadmap, not just necessary improvements to Siri. 彭博社记者 Mark Gurman 称，Ternus 近几周与 Federighi 举行了闭门会议，对苹果 AI 的推进速度不满，要求加快路线图，不要止步于对 Siri 的必要改进。

Ternus stated on last week's first earnings call that Siri currently primarily operates in a request-based mode, but its modern orchestrator-driven architecture leaves room for future expansion of capabilities. Ternus 在上周的首次财报电话会上表示，Siri 目前主要仍是基于请求的模式，但其基于编排器驱动的现代架构，为未来扩展能力留出了空间。

Regarding agent capabilities, he said it's a promising tool, but it's necessary to ensure users are clear about what permissions they have granted and to protect security and privacy. 对于智能体能力，他称这是有前景的工具，但需要确保用户清楚自己授予了哪些权限，并保护安全和隐私。

Gurman believes that Siri still has a significant gap compared to ChatGPT Dots, Meta Muse, and Grok, which can take over continuous tasks, remember across conversations, and proactively push information; Apple has also not yet launched features similar to "computer usage." He expects Apple might make Siri closer to an agent as early as next year. Gurman 认为，Siri 与 ChatGPT Dots、Meta Muse 和 Grok 等仍有明显差距，后者可接手持续性任务、跨对话记忆并主动推送信息；苹果也尚未推出类似「计算机使用」的功能。他预计苹果最早可能在明年让 Siri 更接近智能体。

item.title: 苹果称超 10 万款应用已适配 iPhone Duo
item.guid: 苹果称超-10-万款应用已适配-iPhone-Duo
item.description:
Apple announced on November 6 that over 100,000 apps have been optimized for the foldable iPhone Duo, which has been on the market for about two weeks. According to MacRumors' verification with Apple, this number refers to apps built with iOS 27.1 SDK or higher, which can fill the full width of both inner and outer screens and move controls to the status bar. 苹果在 11 月 6 日宣布，上市约两周的折叠屏 iPhone Duo 已有超过 10 万款应用完成优化。据 MacRumors 向苹果求证，这一数字指基于 iOS 27.1 SDK 或更高版本构建的应用，可铺满内外屏全宽，并将控件移至状态栏。

Apple previously mentioned in a press release that Weibo, iQiyi, WPS Office, Amap, Xiaohongshu, Taobao, and Xmind have been optimized for the iPhone Duo. 苹果此前在新闻稿提到，微博、爱奇艺、WPS Office、高德地图、小红书、淘宝和 Xmind 已针对 iPhone Duo 做了优化。

However, a large number of apps have not yet been adapted. MacRumors listed unadapted apps including Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams, Steam, PayPal, and YouTube Music, with Apple's own Apple Store app also among them. 不过，仍有大量应用尚未适配。MacRumors 列出的未适配应用包括 Google 办公套件、Microsoft Teams、Steam、PayPal 和 YouTube Music， 苹果自家的 Apple Store 应用也在其中。

适配程度分为三档： 适配程度分为三档：

  • Apps built with iOS 27.1 SDK can fill both inner and outer screens; 用 iOS 27.1 SDK 构建的应用可铺满内外屏；
  • Apps built with iOS 27 SDK can fill most of the inner screen area but will avoid the right-side status bar; 用 iOS 27 SDK 构建的应用可填满内屏大部分区域，但会避开右侧状态栏；
  • Apps built with iOS 26 or earlier SDK can only run centered, with black bars on both sides. 用 iOS 26 或更早 SDK 构建的应用只能居中运行，两侧留有黑边。

Apple states that apps using standard SwiftUI and UIKit components can automatically adapt, and thousands of optimized apps are still being released daily. 苹果称，使用标准 SwiftUI 和 UIKit 组件的应用可自动适配，每天仍有数千款优化后的应用上架。

item.title: 英伟达 1140 万美元货物被盗
item.guid: 英伟达-1140-万美元货物被盗
item.description:
According to the Los Angeles Times, Oakland, California police are investigating a major theft involving Nvidia cargo, with the stolen items being AI chips and computer hardware, valued at up to $11.4 million (approximately 76.1 million RMB). 据洛杉矶时报报道，美国加州奥克兰警方正在调查一起涉及英伟达货物的重大盗窃案， 被盗物品为 AI 芯片和计算机硬件，价值高达 1140 万美元（约合 7610 万元人民币）。

Reports indicate that six pallets of Nvidia cargo were originally scheduled to be shipped from Oakland to Fort Worth, Texas, but after being picked up by a truck on August 29, the truck subsequently went missing. 报道称，6 托盘英伟达货物原定从奥克兰运往得克萨斯州沃思堡，但在 8 月 29 日被一辆卡车提走后，卡车随后失联。

Police attempted to track the vehicle, eventually losing its trace in San Bernardino County. Oakland police confirmed that the theft was reported on September 13 and is currently under investigation, but declined to release further details. 警方曾尝试追踪该车辆，最终在圣贝纳迪诺县失去踪迹。奥克兰警方确认，该盗窃案已于 9 月 13 日报案，目前仍在调查中，但拒绝公布更多细节。

According to CCTV Finance, the truck made multiple stops along the way, with single stops lasting several hours. Experts say that the relevant chips sell for nearly twice the price outside the U.S. compared to domestically, and it's not ruled out that the stolen goods have been transported out of the country. 另据央视财经消息，这辆卡车途中曾多次停靠，单次停留长达数小时。专家称，相关芯片在美国境外的售价接近美国本土的两倍，不排除赃物已被转运出境。

CCTV Finance stated that this is not the first time Nvidia has experienced cargo theft. 央视财经称，这并非英伟达首次遭遇货物被盗。

item.title: Anthropic 拟于本周启动 IPO 路演
item.guid: Anthropic-拟于本周启动-IPO-路演
item.description:
According to 《The Information》 on November 6 local time, Anthropic plans to launch its IPO roadshow during the week of November 9. Previously, Reuters cited sources saying that potential investors had raised questions about the original roadshow and listing timetable. 据《The Information》当地时间 11 月 6 日报道，Anthropic 计划在 11 月 9 日当周启动 IPO 路演。此前路透社援引知情人士称，潜在投资者曾对原定的路演和上市时间表提出疑问。

《The Information》 previously reported that Anthropic aims to go public before Thanksgiving in the U.S. 《The Information》此前报道，Anthropic 的目标是在美国感恩节前挂牌。

The company updated its prospectus on November 2 local time. This disclosure covers the preparation progress, and the roadshow will be used to introduce the offering arrangements to potential investors. 公司已于当地时间 11 月 2 日更新招股文件。此次披露的是筹备进度，路演将用于向潜在投资者介绍发行安排。

Axios reported that investors are re-evaluating Anthropic's listing valuation after the recent tech stock downturn. Investor discussions cited by 《The Wall Street Journal》 and Bloomberg gave different expectations, still in the discussion phase before pricing the offering. Axios 报道称，投资者在近期科技股下跌后重新评估 Anthropic 的上市估值。《华尔街日报》和彭博社援引的投资者讨论给出了不同预期，仍处在发行定价前的讨论阶段。

item.title: 马斯克：SpaceX 明年 12 月年化营收或超 5000 亿美元
item.guid: 马斯克：SpaceX-明年-12-月年化营收或超-5000-亿美元
item.description:
Elon Musk stated at the Barron's Investment Conference on November 6 that, according to SpaceX's current plans, he personally estimates the company's annualized revenue could exceed $500 billion by December 2027. This is an annualized figure based on the revenue rate at that time, which Musk referred to as his own estimate. 马斯克在 11 月 6 日的巴伦投资大会上表示，按 SpaceX 目前的计划，他个人估计，公司到 2027 年 12 月的年化营收可能超过 5000 亿美元。这是按届时营收速度折算的年化规模，马斯克把它称为自己的估计。

Regarding the source of growth, Musk placed ground data centers and orbital computing power within the same planning framework. He believes that ground expansion is primarily constrained by power supply and chip availability, and data center construction cannot simply begin once chips are acquired. 谈到增长从何而来，马斯克把地面数据中心和轨道算力放在同一套规划里。他认为，地面扩张首先受制于供电和芯片供应，数据中心建设并非只要拿到芯片就能启动。

SpaceX hopes to reduce launch costs with reusable Starship vehicles, creating conditions for sending computing equipment into orbit. SpaceX 希望用可重复使用的星舰降低发射成本，为把计算设备送入轨道创造条件。

He also discussed Tesla's business in China. Taking the Model Y as an example, he said that it's not easy for this car, produced at the Shanghai factory, to achieve sales success in the Chinese market due to the strong competitiveness of Chinese car manufacturers. He also said he likes going to China and finds traveling there inspiring. 他还谈到特斯拉在中国的业务。以 Model Y 为例，他说上海工厂生产的这款车在中国市场取得销量成绩并不容易，原因是中国车企的竞争力很强。 他也说自己喜欢去中国，觉得在中国旅行让人受到启发。

Barron compared the revenue estimate with SpaceX's historical scale during the interview. The annualized revenue mentioned by both refers to the income rate at a specific point in time and cannot be directly compared with the company's full-year revenue from previous years on the same basis. 巴伦在访谈中将营收估计与 SpaceX 历史规模作比较。两人口中的年化营收是特定时点的收入速度，不能直接与公司过去完整年度的营收作同口径比较。

Regarding a more recent timeframe, Musk also predicted that fourth-quarter revenue growth would exceed 50%. 谈及更近的时间点，马斯克还预计第四季度营收增幅将超过五成。

item.title: Meta 首席战略官将离职，出任 Fireworks 首席财务官
item.guid: Meta-首席战略官将离职，出任-Fireworks-首席财务官
item.description:
Dave Wehner, Meta's Chief Strategy Officer, will leave the company to become the Chief Financial Officer of AI inference platform Fireworks. Lin Qiao, co-founder and CEO of Fireworks, has confirmed this appointment. Meta 首席战略官戴夫·韦纳将离开公司，出任 AI 推理平台 Fireworks 的首席财务官。Fireworks 联合创始人兼 CEO 林乔已确认这项任命。

Wehner joined Facebook in 2012 and was promoted to Chief Financial Officer in 2014. In 2022, he became Meta's first Chief Strategy Officer, responsible for corporate strategy and development, with Susan Li taking over as CFO. 韦纳 2012 年加入 Facebook，2014 年升任首席财务官。2022 年，他成为 Meta 首位首席战略官，负责公司战略和企业发展，首席财务官一职由苏珊·李接任。

Fireworks provides model training and inference services for enterprises. Lin Qiao mentioned when announcing the appointment that the company hopes enterprises can build dedicated AI using their own data, knowledge, and business experience, and design model training and inference together. Fireworks 为企业提供模型训练和推理服务。林乔在宣布任命时提到，公司希望企业能用自己的数据、知识和业务经验打造专用 AI，并将模型训练和推理一并设计。

item.title: 比亚迪李柯回应玛莎拉蒂收购传闻
item.guid: 比亚迪李柯回应玛莎拉蒂收购传闻
item.description:
Stella Li, Executive Vice President of BYD, was asked again about her interest in acquiring Maserati during an interview with 《Ticino Post》 in Abu Dhabi. 比亚迪执行副总裁李柯在阿布扎比接受《提契诺邮报》采访时，再次被问到是否有意收购玛莎拉蒂。

She stated that she might have been more interested a few years ago, but now BYD has forged its own path, and developing its own brand is easier and better reflects the company's judgment on technology. She had said in May this year that established car manufacturers like Maserati were very attractive, but no specific acquisition operations were undertaken at that time. 她表示，几年前可能更感兴趣，现在比亚迪已经走出自己的路，发展自有品牌更容易，也更能体现公司对技术的判断。她今年 5 月曾表示玛莎拉蒂这样的老牌车企很有吸引力，当时没有开展具体收购操作。

The interview took place during the celebration of the Yangwang U9 Xtreme breaking a speed record. The car, driven by German driver Marc Basseng, achieved a one-way speed of 503.17 km/h on a closed road in the UAE. Stella Li said that technologies demonstrated on this car, such as high-voltage architecture, can be applied to other BYD mass-produced models in the future. 采访是在仰望 U9 Xtreme 庆祝刷新速度纪录期间进行的。这辆车由德国车手马克·巴森驾驶，在阿联酋封闭道路上单向跑出 503.17km/h。李柯说，高压架构等在这辆车上展示的技术，今后可以用到比亚迪其他量产车型。

item.title: 成都一男子戴 AI 眼镜考驾照作弊，现场演示多选题全错
item.guid: 成都一男子戴-AI-眼镜考驾照作弊，现场演示多选题全错
item.description:
According to CCTV News, on October 16, a man in Chengdu cheated in the theory test for an additional motorcycle driving license using AI glasses and a smart ring. On-site police officers noticed him repeatedly fiddling with his glasses and ring, approached to check, and the man admitted that he bought the equipment online to assist with answering questions. He had previously taken the theory test for a car driving license 4 times before passing. 据央视新闻报道，10 月 16 日，成都一名男子在增驾摩托车驾照的理论考试中使用 AI 眼镜和智能戒指作弊。驻场民警发现他反复摆弄眼镜和戒指，上前核查，男子承认设备是他从网上买来辅助答题的。 他此前申领汽车驾照时，理论考试考了 4 次才通过。

During the investigation, the man practiced questions on his phone with an accuracy rate of over 85%. The police then randomly selected questions and asked him to demonstrate using the device, but he answered all the multiple-choice questions incorrectly. Chengdu traffic police fined him and prohibited him from applying for a motor vehicle driving license again within one year. 调查中，男子自己在手机上刷题，正确率超过 85%。民警另行随机抽题，让他用设备演示，抽到的多选题全部答错。成都交警对他作出罚款处罚，一年内不得再次申领机动车驾驶证。

item.title: 中国移动启动 6G 智能应用共创行动，上海将办 6G 发展大会
item.guid: 中国移动启动-6G-智能应用共创行动，上海将办-6G-发展大会
item.description:
On November 6, Wang Xiaoyun, Chief Engineer of China Mobile, announced the launch of the 6G Intelligent Application Co-creation Initiative at the Mobile Network Conference held in Guangzhou. According to C114 Communication Network, China Mobile will open a set of cross-city, cross-site network experimental devices for partners to incubate applications, develop products, and conduct end-to-end verification. The first batch of directions includes networked robots, AI terminals, immersive communication, and industrial intelligence, with plans to promote a hundred R&D tasks and gather a thousand partners. 11 月 6 日，中国移动总工程师王晓云在广州举行的移动网络大会上宣布启动 6G 智能应用共创行动。据 C114 通信网报道，中国移动将开放一套跨城市、跨站点的网络试验装置，供合作伙伴孵化应用、开发产品并做端到端验证。首批方向包括网联机器人、AI 终端、沉浸式通信和工业智能等，计划推动百项研发任务并聚合千家伙伴。

On the same day, the press briefing for the 2026 6G Development Conference announced that the conference will be held in Songjiang, Shanghai, from November 24 to 25. According to Yicai, the conference will discuss 6G standard formulation and showcase R&D achievements such as base station prototypes and intelligent core network prototypes. Shanghai will also unveil a 6G concept verification platform at the opening ceremony. 同日，2026 年 6G 发展大会新闻通气会公布，大会将于 11 月 24 日至 25 日在上海松江举行。据第一财经报道，会议将讨论 6G 标准制定，并展示基站原型、智能体核心网样机等研发成果。上海还将在开幕式上揭牌 6G 概念验证平台。

Shanghai Smart Link Information Technology Research Institute and Shanghai University plan to release a 6G base station prototype system using domestic computing power at the conference, as well as a dataset including new spectrum and multi-modal channel measurements. 上海智联信息技术研究院和上海大学计划在大会上发布一套使用国产算力的 6G 基站原型系统，以及包含新频谱和多模态信道测量的数据集。

item.title: 上纬新材两款消费级机器人累计下线 1 万台
item.guid: 上纬新材两款消费级机器人累计下线-1-万台
item.description:
Swancor Advanced Materials announced on November 8 that a total of 10,000 units of the two consumer-grade embodied intelligent robots, Qiyuan Q1 and Qiyuan T1, released on September 20, have rolled off the production line. The company stated that production capacity is currently ramping up, and yield performance is good. 上纬新材 11 月 8 日公告，9 月 20 日发布的两款消费级具身智能机器人启元 Q1 和启元 T1，合计已有 1 万台下线。公司称，目前产能正在爬坡，良率表现良好。

This disclosure concerns production progress. Swancor Advanced Materials stated in the announcement that the consumer-grade robot business is still in its initial stage, with a relatively low revenue contribution currently. Production capacity, yield, and promotion progress will all affect future business performance. 这次披露的是生产端进度。上纬新材在公告中称，消费级机器人业务仍处于起步期，目前营收占比较低，产能、良率和推广进度均会影响后续业务表现。

item.title: NASA 推进核动力月球车项目，目标 2028 年底发射
item.guid: NASA-推进核动力月球车项目，目标-2028-年底发射
item.description:
NASA will advance the development of the nuclear-powered lunar rover PROMISE, aiming for a launch by the end of 2028, with a planned 18-month mission on the lunar surface. Blue Origin will use its Mark 1 lander to deliver this six-wheeled rover to the Moon's south pole. NASA 将推进核动力月球车 PROMISE 的研制，目标在 2028 年底发射，计划在月面执行为期 18 个月的任务。蓝色起源将用 Mark 1 着陆器把这辆六轮月球车送到月球南极。

The lunar rover will extend a drill about 1 meter below the lunar surface to analyze ice and other resources in the lunar soil. It will also carry a spectrometer, temperature and radiation sensors, and a visible light camera to collect data for subsequent landing site and base selection. Nuclear power will allow it to operate during the long lunar night and in permanently shadowed regions that may contain ice. 月球车将把钻头伸到月面下约 1 米，分析月壤中的冰和其他资源。车上还会搭载光谱仪、温度和辐射传感器及可见光相机，收集可用于后续着陆点和基地选址的数据。核动力允许它在漫长月夜及可能含冰的永久阴影区工作。

NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, responsible for its construction, will reuse flight spares and engineering test models from the "Curiosity" and "Perseverance" Mars rovers to shorten the time required for full vehicle integration and testing. 负责建造的 NASA 喷气推进实验室将复用「好奇号」和「毅力号」火星车的飞行备件及工程测试样机，缩短整车集成和测试所需时间。

item.title: 文远知行韩旭谈 Robotaxi 规模化，希望未来可从广州直达香港
item.guid: 文远知行韩旭谈-Robotaxi-规模化，希望未来可从广州直达香港
item.description:
Han Xu, founder and CEO of WeRide, told CNBC during Hong Kong FinTech Week that the company believes the hardware, software, and supporting ecosystem are largely ready to expand its Robotaxi fleet, and the next challenge is how regulation can keep pace. He hopes to be able to take a Robotaxi directly from Guangzhou to Hong Kong within four or five years. 文远知行创始人兼 CEO 韩旭在香港金融科技周接受 CNBC 采访时说，公司认为硬件、软件和配套生态已基本具备扩大 Robotaxi 车队的条件，接下来要解决的是监管如何跟上。 他希望四、五年内能坐 Robotaxi 从广州直达香港。

Han Xu said that WeRide has already conducted trial operations or small-scale operations in over 13 countries. To scale up the fleet, regulatory agencies need tools to continuously monitor vehicles and their algorithms. In Hong Kong, WeRide has partnered with Geely Remote and Kwoon Chung Bus Holdings to advance right-hand drive autonomous vehicles. 韩旭说，文远知行已经在超过 13 个国家试运营或开展小规模运营。要把车队做大，监管机构需要有工具持续监测车辆及其算法。香港方面，文远知行已与吉利远程和冠忠巴士集团合作推进右舵自动驾驶车型。

item.title: SpaceX 公布星舰第 15 次试飞窗口，拟用发射塔接住两级火箭
item.guid: SpaceX-公布星舰第-15-次试飞窗口，拟用发射塔接住两级火箭
item.description:
SpaceX has set a launch window for Starship's 15th test flight. According to current plans, Starship could lift off from Starbase in Texas as early as 4:45 PM Central Time on November 13 (6:45 AM Beijing Time on November 14), pending regulatory approval. SpaceX 为星舰第 15 次试飞设定了发射窗口。按目前计划，星舰最早将于美国中部时间 11 月 13 日下午 4 点 45 分（北京时间 11 月 14 日早上 6 点 45 分）从得州星际基地升空，发射仍需监管部门批准。

This test flight aims to have both the Super Heavy booster and the Starship upper stage return to the launch site, to be caught by the launch tower's mechanical arm. According to the plan, the booster will attempt to return approximately 6 to 8 minutes after liftoff, while the upper stage will attempt to return approximately 22 hours after flight. Both recovery attempts will only be executed if flight safety conditions are met. 这次试飞拟让超重型助推器和星舰上面级都飞回发射场，由发射塔机械臂接住。按计划，助推器将在升空约 6 至 8 分钟后尝试返回，上面级则将在飞行约 22 小时后尝试返回。两次回收都要满足飞行安全条件才会执行。

item.title: 亚马逊组建新团队开发家用机器人，招聘涉及家庭交互与售后
item.guid: 亚马逊组建新团队开发家用机器人，招聘涉及家庭交互与售后
item.description:
According to CNBC, Amazon has assembled a team over the past few months to develop new home robots. A now-removed engineering job posting for the team stated that the product would need to navigate a home with changing layouts and objects, and operate autonomously around family members. 据 CNBC 报道，亚马逊过去数月组建了一支团队开发新的家用机器人。该团队一份已下架的工程岗位曾写到，产品需要能在布局和物品不断变化的家里导航，并在家人身边自主运行。

Amazon acquired Fauna Robotics, developer of the humanoid robot Sprout, in March this year, integrating it into its personal robotics division. Job postings for Fauna's interaction design and software development roles are still visible on Amazon's website, involving enabling robots to convey intent through actions and dialogue, and building cloud services for robot device clusters, respectively. CNBC also found recruitment information for customer support and on-site repair. 亚马逊今年 3 月收购了开发人形机器人 Sprout 的 Fauna Robotics，将其纳入个人机器人部门。亚马逊官网上仍可看到 Fauna 的交互设计和软件开发岗位，分别涉及让机器人通过动作和对话传达意图，以及为机器人设备群搭建云端服务。CNBC 还发现了负责客户支持和现场维修的招聘信息。

Amazon's previous home robot, Astro, which can move around the house and patrol with a camera, has always been sold by invitation. An Amazon spokesperson told CNBC that the company is still providing support for Astro users. 亚马逊上一款家用机器人 Astro 能在家中移动并用摄像头巡视，一直采用邀请制销售。亚马逊发言人向 CNBC 表示，公司仍在为 Astro 用户提供支持。

item.title: 猫王权利方与 Eminem 音乐出版商分别起诉 Suno
item.guid: 猫王权利方与-Eminem-音乐出版商分别起诉-Suno
item.description:
The rights holders of Elvis Presley and Eight Mile Style, the publisher managing some of Eminem's song copyrights, have separately sued the AI music generation platform Suno in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California. Both lawsuits were filed on November 6 local time. 猫王埃尔维斯·普雷斯利的权利方和管理 Eminem 部分歌曲版权的出版商 Eight Mile Style，分别向美国加州北区联邦地区法院起诉 AI 音乐生成平台 Suno。两起诉讼均于当地时间 11 月 6 日提交。

Elvis Presley's rights holders allege that Suno used their managed works without authorization to train its model and allowed users to generate songs imitating Elvis's voice. The plaintiffs cited Tennessee's "ELVIS Act," which protects voice and likeness, and the complaint included audio examples generated by the platform. Eight Mile Style and co-plaintiffs claim that Suno unauthorizedly copied 269 Eminem works they manage for training, and the generated lyrics reproduce content from the original works. 猫王权利方指控，Suno 未经授权使用其管理的作品训练模型，并让用户生成模仿猫王嗓音的歌曲。原告援引田纳西州保护声音及形象的《ELVIS 法案》，诉状还附有平台生成的音频示例。Eight Mile Style 与共同原告则称，Suno 未经授权复制其管理的 269 首 Eminem 作品用于训练，生成的歌词还会复现原作品内容。

Suno stated in a statement to Variety that the platform prohibits the unauthorized use of artists' works, does not allow specifying artists or songs in prompts, and collaborates with third parties to screen uploaded audio and lyrics. Suno 在给 Variety 的声明中表示，平台禁止未经授权使用艺人作品，不允许在提示词中指定艺人或歌曲，并与第三方合作筛查上传的音频和歌词。

item.title: 💡 腾讯姚顺雨谈大模型的壁垒：谁更懂用户，谁更值得托付
item.guid: 💡-腾讯姚顺雨谈大模型的壁垒：谁更懂用户，谁更值得托付
item.description:
According to Yicai, during a dialogue at the 2026 Future Science Prize, Zhang Yaqin asked Yao Shunyu, Tencent's Chief AI Scientist, what model companies rely on to retain users when developers can switch to other models or even combine several intelligent agents. 据第一财经报道，在 2026 未来科学大奖的一场对话中，张亚勤问腾讯首席 AI 科学家姚顺雨，当开发者可以换用其他模型，甚至把几个智能体搭配起来用时，模型公司靠什么留住用户？

Yao Shunyu believes that more lasting barriers come from the unique data a product possesses, its understanding of user context, and how much users are willing to entrust to it. 姚顺雨认为， 更持久的壁垒来自产品掌握的独有数据、对用户情境的理解，以及用户愿意交给它多少事。

He cited WeChat as an example. If users could directly use AI within WeChat, schedule, contact, and activity information could help it understand user needs. Even if another model is more capable, it would be difficult to provide the same service without this information. 他以微信举例。假如用户能直接在微信里用 AI，日程、联系人和活动信息可以帮助它理解用户的需求。即使另一款模型能力更强，缺少这些信息也很难提供同样的服务。

Yao Shunyu also mentioned that after AI starts performing tasks for users, whether users are willing to share personal information depends on their trust in the product's data handling and task execution. 姚顺雨还提到，AI 开始替用户执行任务后，用户是否愿意开放个人信息，取决于用户对产品处理数据和执行任务的信任。

Discussing open-source models, he used cybersecurity as an example, pointing out that after general reasoning and programming capabilities improve, models might learn to exploit vulnerabilities even without specifically learning attack content. He advocated for automated and manual evaluations before release and continued monitoring for harmful calls after launch. 谈到模型开源，他以网络安全为例，指出通用推理和编程能力提升后，模型即便没有专门学习攻击内容，也可能学会利用漏洞。他主张在发布前做自动化与人工评估，上线后继续监测有害调用。

item.title: 仰望首款行政旗舰轿车鼎曜在阿布扎比亮相
item.guid: 仰望首款行政旗舰轿车鼎曜在阿布扎比亮相
item.description:
Yangwang's first executive flagship sedan, the Dingyao, debuted in Abu Dhabi, known overseas as YANGWANG ALTIOR. Technical data released by BYD shows that the new car is equipped with a second-generation Blade Battery, with a CLTC comprehensive pure electric range exceeding 1000 kilometers. Yangwang's official Chinese website has opened pre-market orders. 仰望首款行政旗舰轿车鼎曜在阿布扎比首发，海外名为 YANGWANG ALTIOR。比亚迪公布的技术资料显示，新车搭载第二代刀片电池，CLTC 综合工况纯电续航超过 1000 公里。仰望中国官网已开放上市前订购。

The new car features a four-seat layout, with a length of 5.6 meters and a wheelbase of 3.5 meters, and front and rear doors that open in opposite directions. The right rear passenger can fold the front passenger seat with one click, creating more vision and legroom. The two rear zero-gravity seats are equipped with mechanical massage devices, which can be linked with leg rests, sunshades, and ambient lighting. 新车采用四座布局，车长 5.6 米、轴距 3.5 米，前后车门对开。右后座乘客可一键折叠前排副驾座椅，腾出视野和腿部空间。两张后排零重力座椅配有机械按摩装置，可联动腿托、遮阳帘和氛围灯。

The e⁴ platform uses 4 independent motors to adjust the torque of each wheel, capable of adjusting driving force over 100 times per second, supporting in-place U-turns, and also used for vehicle stability control during high-speed tire blowouts. The active suspension senses the road ahead and adjusts in real-time to suppress bumps and body sway during cornering. 易四方平台用 4 台独立电机调节各轮扭矩，每秒可调整驱动力超过 100 次，支持原地掉头，也用于高速爆胎时的车辆稳定控制。主动悬架会感知前方路面并实时调整，抑制颠簸和过弯时的车身摆动。

For assisted driving, the Dingyao is equipped with the Eye of God A system, supporting parking-to-parking navigation, highway and urban navigation, and parking assistance. 辅助驾驶方面，鼎曜搭载天神之眼 A，支持车位到车位领航、高速和城区领航以及泊车辅助。

item.title: 腾讯元宝搜索开放独立网页入口，支持 AI 问答和普通搜索
item.guid: 腾讯元宝搜索开放独立网页入口，支持-AI-问答和普通搜索
item.description:
Tencent's "Yuanbao Search" has opened an independent web portal. According to "Product Notes" actual tests, the homepage defaults to AI search, where users can input questions or upload images to continue asking. The results page displays answers and reference materials side-by-side, making it convenient to open web pages for verification. 腾讯的「元宝搜索」已开放独立网页入口。按「产品笔记」实测，首页默认进入 AI 搜索，用户可以输入问题，也可以上传图片后继续提问。结果页并排显示回答和参考资料，方便打开网页核对。

After switching to regular search, users can browse conventional web results by keywords or specifically search for official account articles. Academic Q&A can list paper references as required. On October 20, Tencent Cloud first provided Yuanbao Search API and MCP access to developers, with a search scope including public web pages and Tencent ecosystem content. 切换到普通搜索后，可以按关键词浏览常规网页结果，也能单独查找公众号文章。学术问答可按要求列出论文资料。10 月 20 日，腾讯云已先向开发者提供元宝搜索 API 和 MCP 接入，检索范围包括公开网页和腾讯生态内容。

item.title: 微软更新 Windows 11，优化 8G 内存电脑表现
item.guid: 微软更新-Windows-11，优化-8G-内存电脑表现
item.description:
Microsoft introduced optimizations for Windows 11 on 8GB RAM computers. The system adjusted the timing of compressing memory and swapping data to storage devices, allowing up to 2GB more active data to remain in memory, reducing re-reads when switching back to applications or web pages. 微软介绍了 Windows 11 对 8GB 内存电脑的优化。系统调整了压缩内存和把数据换出到存储设备的时机，最多能多保留 2GB 活跃数据在内存里，减少切回应用或网页时重新读取的情况。

Microsoft conducted a comparative test using an HP OmniBook 3 equipped with 8GB RAM and Snapdragon X Plus. It successively opened 20 Edge tabs, a 4K video, large Word, PowerPoint, and Excel files, then opened Outlook and File Explorer, keeping all open programs running throughout. This process completed up to 40% faster on the new version compared to the January version. 微软用一台配备 8GB 内存和骁龙 X Plus 的惠普 OmniBook 3 做了对照测试。依次打开 20 个 Edge 标签页、一个 4K 视频、体积较大的 Word、PowerPoint 和 Excel 文件，再打开 Outlook 和文件资源管理器，全程保持已打开的程序运行。这套流程在新版上的完成速度最多比 1 月的版本快 40%。

Microsoft also changed widgets on 8GB and below computers to load only when opened, reducing committed memory usage by about 200MB when closed. Users can check for updates via Windows Update and update Edge, Microsoft 365, and Teams separately. 微软也把 8GB 及以下电脑的小组件改为打开时才加载，关闭时约少占用 200MB 的已提交内存。用户可通过 Windows Update 检查更新，并分别更新 Edge、Microsoft 365 和 Teams。

item.title: 腾讯游戏陪伴应用「鹅次元」开放首测
item.guid: 腾讯游戏陪伴应用「鹅次元」开放首测
item.description:
Tencent's AI companion application "E-Dimensional" for PC game players has opened its first beta test. The Windows version can be logged in with QQ or WeChat, and the first test offers 4 virtual characters, each with different voices and personalities. 腾讯面向端游玩家的 AI 陪伴应用「鹅次元」开放首测。Windows 版可用 QQ 或微信登录，首测提供 4 个虚拟角色，音色和性格各不相同。

Players can talk to characters in real-time while playing games. The application understands scenes in supported games through visual recognition, with the first test covering titles like "Phantom Blade Zero." Conversations can also be conducted via text, voice messages, and images, and character speech can be interrupted during real-time calls. 玩家可以一边打游戏一边和角色实时通话。应用通过画面识别理解受支持游戏中的场景，首测覆盖《影之刃零》等作品。对话也能通过文字、语音消息和图片进行，实时通话中可以打断角色的发言。

item.title: DaVinci Resolve 更新，支持触屏 MacBook Pro
item.guid: DaVinci-Resolve-更新，支持触屏-MacBook-Pro
item.description:
Blackmagic Design released DaVinci Resolve 21.2, with both the free and Studio versions adding support for MacBook Pro models equipped with PROLED XDR touchscreens. CineD noted that Blackmagic's update notes only listed touchscreen compatibility and did not yet list directly operable pages and controls. Blackmagic Design 发布 DaVinci Resolve 21.2，免费版和 Studio 版均加入对搭载 PROLED XDR 触屏的 MacBook Pro 的支持。CineD 指出，Blackmagic 的更新说明只列出了触屏兼容，尚未列出可以直接操作的页面和控件。

Both versions include 6th generation color science LUTs and film styles. During editing, multi-camera clips can be opened in the source timeline, and the original timecode can be preserved after audio extraction. The Studio version's false color tool adds support for 5th and 6th generation color science and updates Fusion's AI assistant and scripting interface. 两版都加入第六代色彩科学 LUT 和胶片风格。剪辑时，多机位片段可在源时间线中打开，提取音频后可保留源时间码。Studio 版的伪色工具新增对第五代和第六代色彩科学的支持，并更新了 Fusion 的 AI 助手和脚本接口。

item.title: 太古可口可乐在进博会公布中国十年战略
item.guid: 太古可口可乐在进博会公布中国十年战略
item.description:
Swire Coca-Cola unveiled its "Winning 2035" ten-year strategy for the Chinese market at the CIIE. The company plans to adjust products according to scenarios like dining, social gatherings, and home consumption, continue customization with retail clients, and apply digital tools to store services, warehousing, and supply chain. 太古可口可乐在进博会上公布面向中国市场的「致胜 2035」十年战略。公司计划按聚餐、社交和居家等场景调整产品，继续和零售客户做定制，并把数字工具用于门店服务、仓储与供应链。

Examples presented at the exhibition included 420ml customized sodas and 150ml Qoo beverages in collaboration with Wanchen Group. In the warehousing segment, the company showcased robots capable of identifying goods by order, picking, and mixed palletizing. On the production side, Swire Coca-Cola stated that its hot water center solution now covers 80% of its soda factories in mainland China, with the first two generations of solutions collectively reducing steam consumption by approximately 35%. 展会上给出的案例包括与万辰集团合作的 420ml 定制汽水和 150ml 酷儿饮料。仓储环节，公司展示了可按订单识别货品、拣选并混合码垛的机器人。生产端，太古可口可乐称，其热水中心方案已覆盖中国内地八成汽水工厂，前两代方案合计减少约 35% 的蒸汽用量。

item.title: 4.8 万元，保时捷与 La Marzocco 推出 911 联名咖啡机
item.guid: 4.8-万元，保时捷与-La-Marzocco-推出-911-联名咖啡机
item.description:
Porsche and La Marzocco have collaborated again, launching the Linea Micra espresso machine and Pico grinder, inspired by the 1972 911 Carrera RS 2.7. 保时捷与 La Marzocco 再度联名，推出以 1972 年的 911 Carrera RS 2.7 为设计灵感的 Linea Micra 意式咖啡机和 Pico 磨豆机。

The cup holder on top of the coffee machine is shaped like the original car's ducktail spoiler, the handles are engraved with "RS" and "2.7", and the pressure gauge uses red and green pointers to match the car's color scheme. 咖啡机顶部的杯架取形自原车的鸭尾扰流板，手柄刻有「RS」和「2.7」，压力表用红绿指针呼应车身配色。

The two main color schemes are Grand Prix White with Green and Orange with Black, with 911 units of each coffee machine limited. Grand Prix White with Blue is exclusive to Germany, limited to 150 units. The Linea Micra retains handles that can switch between single, double, and bottomless spouts, has a 2-liter water tank capacity, and allows temperature and timer adjustments via a mobile app. 两款主力配色为大奖赛白配绿和橘色配黑，咖啡机各限量 911 台。大奖赛白配蓝是德国专供，限量 150 台。Linea Micra 保留可在单嘴、双嘴和无底之间切换的手柄，水箱容量 2 升，可用手机 App 调整温度和定时。

Among them, the grinder sells for 12,800 yuan, the coffee machine for 48,200 yuan, and the combined set for 61,000 yuan. 其中，磨豆机单卖 12800 元，咖啡机为 48200 元，二者组合套装为 61000 元。

item.title: Wendy’s 推出像素 RPG，打赢首领有机会解锁餐食优惠
item.guid: Wendy’s-推出像素-RPG，打赢首领有机会解锁餐食优惠
item.description:
American fast-food chain Wendy's has launched a free pixel RPG, "WendyQuest," available on iOS, Android, and Steam. Players take on the role of the brand mascot, Wendy, traversing 5 food-themed areas like forests, deserts, and snowy mountains, to fight against the villain Dr. MechBorg, who has cursed local residents with "mechanization." 美国快餐连锁 Wendy’s 推出免费像素 RPG《WendyQuest》，登陆 iOS、Android 和 Steam。玩家扮演品牌吉祥物 Wendy，穿过以森林、沙漠和雪山等食物主题布置的 5 个区域，对抗让当地居民染上「机械化」诅咒的反派 Dr. MechBorg。

Combat is turn-based, and hitting the right timing can increase damage. American players who defeat a boss have the chance to unlock meal discounts, which must be redeemed within the Wendy's App; some offers require purchasing an item. 战斗采用回合制，按对时机可以提高伤害。美国玩家打赢首领后有机会解锁餐食优惠，需在 Wendy’s App 内兑换，部分优惠须与商品同购。

item.title: Take-Two CEO 谈《GTA 6》盗版风险：必要时会用法律和技术手段处理
item.guid: Take-Two-CEO-谈《GTA-6》盗版风险：必要时会用法律和技术手段处理
item.description:
Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick stated in an interview with The Wall Street Journal that piracy is a long-standing issue for the entertainment industry. If piracy causes a real impact, the company will take both legal and technical measures. Take-Two 首席执行官施特劳斯·泽尔尼克接受《华尔街日报》采访时表示，盗版是娱乐行业长期面对的问题。如果盗版造成实际影响，公司会同时采取法律和技术手段。

Zelnick believes that games might be less affected by piracy than movies and music. He noted that game files are often larger, content is more complex, and some experiences rely on server connections. According to Rockstar's announced schedule, "GTA 6" will launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19. 泽尔尼克认为，游戏受盗版影响可能小于电影和音乐。他提到，游戏文件往往更大，内容也更复杂，部分体验还依赖与服务器的连接。按 Rockstar 公布的安排，《GTA 6》将于 11 月 19 日登陆 PS5 和 Xbox Series X|S。

Additionally, former Rockstar technical director Obbe Vermeij recently stated that as AI models improve in game decompilation and porting capabilities, Rockstar might need to reconsider its long-standing "console first, then PC" release strategy for "GTA 6." 另外，前 Rockstar 技术总监奥贝·维尔梅伊近日表示，随着 AI 模型在游戏反编译和移植方面能力提升，Rockstar 可能需要重新考虑《GTA 6》长期以来「先主机、后 PC」的发行策略。

Given the multiple large-scale leaks of "GTA 6" that have already occurred, he believes that once the console game package leaks, enthusiasts using AI to port it could outpace Take-Two's legal team in addressing related issues. 由于《GTA 6》此前已经发生过多次大规模泄露，他认为， 一旦主机平台游戏包流出，爱好者利用 AI 进行移植的速度可能超过 Take-Two 法务团队处理相关问题的速度。

item.title: 宝可梦动画制作公司 OLM 展示 AI 上色工具
item.guid: 宝可梦动画制作公司-OLM-展示-AI-上色工具
item.description:
OLM, the Japanese animation studio behind "Pokémon" TV anime and films, showcased a coloring tool in Taipei. According to Tatsuo Shikura, director of OLM Digital, at the Taiwan Creative Content Fest, artists first manually complete 3 frames, then the system takes about 90 seconds to learn the work's lines and color scheme, and then about 15 seconds to process one frame. Increasing manual samples can improve accuracy. 制作《宝可梦》电视动画和电影的日本动画公司 OLM 在台北展示了一套上色工具。按 OLM Digital 董事四仓达夫在台湾创意内容大会上的介绍，画师先手工完成 3 帧，系统用约 90 秒学习这部作品的线条与配色，再用约 15 秒处理一帧。增加手工样本可以提高准确度。

Each work is trained only with its own footage. When encountering new characters or creatures, artists can draw a small number of samples first to allow the system to adapt to that character. Tatsuo Shikura estimates that during the proof-of-concept phase, this tool reduced coloring workload by about 30%, while the workload for personnel responsible for frame-by-frame inspection increased. 每部作品只用自己的画面训练。遇到新角色或生物，画师可以先画少量样本，让系统适应该角色。四仓达夫估计，在概念验证阶段，这套工具让上色工作量减少约三成，负责逐帧检查的人员工作量则有所增加。
